summary: Release WT_CURSOR_BTREE buffers when caching a WT_CURSOR
description:
When {{WT_CURSOR}} cursors are cached, we free their key/value buffers. However, those cursors are likely {{WT_CURSOR_BTREE}} cursors underneath, which hold up to 4 additional buffers, which should likely be freed as well.

We could discard those buffers when {{WT_CURSOR.reset}} is called, but that may no be a good idea, given the frequency at which MongoDB server calls that function.

Alternatively, we could add a new Btree level cache function.

The Jenkins job failed with an assertion failure in reconciliation on ocelot. The assertion failure was:

{code}

summary: Modify error message verification for test_prepare04.py
description:
In {{test_prepare04.py}} there are two error messages defined:
{noformat}
conflictmsg = '/conflict between concurrent operations/'
preparemsg = '/conflict with a prepared update/'
{noformat}
but these are never used in any later code. These messages don't appear in any other tests so it isn't a copy/paste error. It seems like there was an intent to test a conflict that was never added.

This should be investigated and either remove the unused lines or add in a test case for those conflicts.
